summary: End-to-end verification of 'Nu Speelt (live)' + Layers panel features. Backend (9/9 pytest passed, test_live_now_playing.py): GET/POST/DELETE /api/sources/live work correctly; new workspaces auto-create a builtin_live source with fields text/title/artist/artwork; POST derives text='Artist - Title'; scene overlay pipeline resolves live values into /public/scene/{token}/values.json (keyed as {sourceId}:text / {sourceId}:artwork) and /data.json (mapped by element name); DELETE empties the values; overlay HTML embeds hidden flag correctly. Frontend (full flow verified end-to-end with yannick admin + MFA): (1) /sources shows a single 'Nu Speelt (live)' card with field pills text/title/artist/artwork and ONLY a delete button (no edit) [del-source-{id} testid]. (2) /scenes/{id} shows the LayersPanel [data-testid=layers-panel] with layer-row-{id}, layer-visible-{id}, layer-delete-{id} for all 3 elements; clicking a row selects (brand-highlighted) and populates the right-side inspector; visibility toggle flips the row icon and the inspector title attribute switches between 'Hide'/'Show'. (3) Selecting the image layer (Logo) exposes 'Live source (optional)' [prop-img-source] and after selecting 'Nu Speelt (live)' the 'Image field' [prop-img-field] select appears with options text/title/artist/artwork. (4) Messages inbox: seeded TEST_LiveFlow form with a song_pick field + submitted one song ('Coldplay - Fix You'); the song row renders [song-live-0] 'Live' button; clicking it (a) shows 'Live gezet in de overlay' toast, (b) renders the top banner [live-now-banner] with artwork + 'Coldplay - Fix You' + 'Wis' button [live-clear-btn]; clicking Wis clears live source and hides the banner.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py _get_or_create_live_source: idempotent per (user_id, workspace_id). Good. Make sure deletion of a workspace cascades builtin_live source cleanup (not verified in this iteration).

server.py build_scene_data: shares source_cache per request so repeated bound elements only resolve once per source - good. api_field branch guards against missing src by returning '', but image branch requires both sourceId and fieldKey (correct).

LayersPanel visibility toggle updates el.hidden only; the public overlay JS checks el.hidden on both scene and pancarte element loops (lines 1268, 1290). Also build_scene_data does NOT skip hidden elements -> hidden api_field/image values still appear as columns in data.json (verified in test_hidden_element_skipped_in_overlay_html). This is likely intentional (vMix data source column stability), but worth confirming with product.
Note: data.json column names come from props.name via _sanitize_key with fallback to type_6charId; if two elements share the same name they'll collide (last-write-wins). Minor edge case.
